expectations.text: Concludes the layout is over-split for an AI-heavy codebase
expectations.evidence: "I'd actually merge most of it back. The layout looks tidy, but 'small and single-purpose' is the wrong target when an AI assistant is one of your main readers."

expectations.text: Recommends merging tightly-coupled view+logic+types into one component file
expectations.evidence: "Merge view + logic + types into UserBadge.tsx... gives the agent the whole component in one read."

expectations.text: Identifies the dumb-view-props-shaped-by-sibling smell (cross-file context the agent won't fetch)
expectations.evidence: "they're very reluctant to look at files other than the one in front of them. They'll make confident edits to UserBadge.view.tsx... break things because the prop shape lives in types.ts... a 'dumb' render file whose meaning lives next door."

expectations.text: Keeps genuinely isolatable styles as a defensible separate file (does not blanket-merge everything)
expectations.evidence: "Keep UserBadge.styles.ts separate if styles are genuinely bulky or use a styling system that wants its own file. Styles are closer to the 'understood in isolation' line."
